description: Scorpion draws two swords, slices off both of the opponent's arms, then swings upward to split the head and torso cleanly in two.
Scorpion opens a hellfire portal and thrusts his arm into it; the arm emerges beneath the opponent and tears the body in half from below.
Liu Kang sets both fists ablaze and pummels the opponent with flaming punches, burning the body down to a charred, smoking husk.
Liu Kang transforms into a giant dragon, lunges, and bites the opponent's upper body off, swallowing it and leaving the legs behind.
Kung Lao lodges his razor-edged hat upright and spinning in the ground, then forces the opponent down onto it, sawing the body in two.
Kung Lao spins his bladed hat like a saw and runs it through the opponent, slicing the whole body cleanly in half.
Sub-Zero freezes the opponent from the feet up to the waist, then rips the upper torso off the frozen lower half.
Sub-Zero rips the spine and skull out through the opponent's chest, freezes the remaining body, and shatters it with the torn-out spine.
Sindel unleashes a point-blank sonic scream at the opponent's head until the skull swells and bursts apart in a spray of blood.

description: Reptile vomits a stream of acid over the opponent, melting the flesh from their bones until only a dripping skeleton remains.
Reptile slashes the opponent's abdomen open, pulls out the spilling intestines, and devours them, leaving the gutted body to collapse.
Kitana drives her steel fans into the opponent's chest and snaps them open, tearing the ribcage and torso wide apart.
Kitana hurls her razor-edged fan to slice the opponent's head in half, splitting the skull straight down the middle.
Johnny Cage rips the opponent's head off along with the dangling spine and holds the severed head aloft.
Johnny Cage splits the opponent's skull with a karate chop, then plants a golden award statuette into the open wound.
Jax seizes the opponent's head in both of his huge metal hands and crushes it until the skull bursts.
Jax tears the opponent in half at the waist and punts the upper body across the arena like a field-goal kick.
Sonya clamps her thighs around the opponent's head, spins through the air, and twists until the upper body tears away.
Sonya slashes the opponent's throat wide open and tears the head free from the body.

Nightwolf summons a spirit tomahawk and chops the top of the opponent's skull clean off, exposing the brain.
Nightwolf calls up a surge of green spirit energy that erupts beneath the opponent, impaling and launching the body skyward.
Stryker clubs the opponent to the ground with his baton, then draws his pistol and shoots them through the head.
Stryker straps grenades onto the opponent, steps back, and detonates them, blowing the body apart in a burst of fire.
Smoke plants a charge inside the opponent and teleports clear as the body bursts apart in a thick cloud of smoke.
Smoke slams the opponent into the ground with a shockwave that pulverizes the body.

Sektor impales the opponent on an upright pole and mounts the limp body in a cross-armed pose, like a scarecrow.
Cyrax deploys a spinning buzzsaw from his chest and runs it up through the opponent, slicing the body in half.
Cyrax snares the opponent in his energy net, then drops a cluster of bombs that detonate, blowing the body to pieces.
Noob Saibot and his shadow clone each grab a leg and tear the opponent in half up the middle, like a wishbone.
Noob Saibot's shadow clone holds the opponent still while Noob slashes the body apart, both halves vanishing into darkness.
Kano punches his fist through the opponent's chest, rips out the still-beating heart, and holds it up as the body falls.
Kano cuts the opponent's chest open, tears out the heart, and takes a bite from it while the body collapses.
Mileena unhinges her monstrous jaws, swallows the opponent whole, and spits out the stripped, picked-clean skeleton.
Mileena drives both sais into the opponent's body and tears it apart in a shower of blood.
Shang Tsung conjures a flintlock pistol and shoots the opponent repeatedly, blasting the head and torso apart.

Kabal sinks both hookswords into the opponent's jaw and rips upward, tearing the face and head apart.

Raiden floods the opponent with electricity until the head swells and bursts, leaving the body twitching and smoking.
Raiden tears the opponent's head off and shoves it down into the gaping cavity of their own chest.
Sheeva seizes the opponent and peels every bit of skin from the body in one pull, leaving a raw, skinless figure.
Sheeva hammers the opponent into the ground with all four of her fists until the body is pounded flat.
Quan Chi rips off one of the opponent's legs and beats them over the head with it until they die.
Quan Chi conjures a sword, slices both the opponent's legs off at the knees, then beheads them as they drop.
Cyber Sub-Zero blasts the opponent with a freezing beam, encasing them in ice, then shatters the frozen body into shards.
Cyber Sub-Zero freezes the opponent's head solid, tears it off with the spine, and the frozen head shatters on the ground.
Skarlet slashes the opponent open and conjures a rising pool of their blood, bathing in it as the body is drained.
Skarlet drains the opponent's blood into the air and lets it rain back down as the withered body collapses.
